5 bikes for cruising along 30A

4-star restaurants

Villa Dolce by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Villa Dolce, a stunning luxury home in Seagrove Beach. This beautifully designed 3,074 sq ft villa features 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, perfect for an ultimate 30A vacation. Your crew will love the private pool and spillover spa. They’ll also enjoy the game room with shuffleboard and foosball, and a large, covered deck with an outdoor grill and dining area overlooking the peaceful pool. Sound like paradise? Well, it is! Step inside to delightful décor and thoughtful touches that make you feel right at home.

The first floor opens to the stylish outside oasis, complete with a game zone and a cozy checker table for two. The chef’s kitchen is fully stocked and perfect for whipping up home-cooked meals. The first-floor primary suite is a peaceful retreat, with a plush king bed, walk-in closet, and private ensuite bathroom featuring a garden tub and large shower. French doors lead to your own outdoor oasis. Very private. Upstairs, a second living area offers a perfect space to relax, surrounded by four more beautifully decorated bedrooms, each with its own private ensuite bathroom. Guests love it here: "This house is spacious and has many positives. We loved the pool since it was great for small children. Each bedroom having its own bathroom was a plus. Probably the best thing was its location to the beach—just a short walk across 30A!" – Gina P. A private pool and five bikes? They could be yours! Super enchanting and mega-fun, come experience the sweet life on 30A at Villa Dolce! Overview: - 212 steps (.1 mile) to the beach (Pelayo Beach Access) - 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths - 3074 sq ft - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 5 bikes included - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) Overnight: - King in 1st floor primary bedroom; private garden tub and shower; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; balcony; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; balcony; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - 2 full beds in 2nd floor guest bedroom; private bath; TV Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
